name: TrackJEV J-stage training registry (pretrained OneJev-0.8B)
trainer: tools/groundjev/onejev_resumable_sft.py (full FP32 masters + Adam + scheduler + all RNG)

J0_frozen.purpose: zero-shot pretrained OneJev baseline: no parameter update at all
J0_frozen.note: the upstream trainer has exactly two modes (LoRA adapter or --full-finetune); it has no frozen-body-plus-new-head mode, because this schema adds no new parameters. The honest frozen arm is therefore the pretrained model evaluated as-is.

J1_lora.purpose: does a small parameter budget suffice for identity decisions?
J1_lora.trainable: LoRA adapters on the language/decision projections + new heads

J2_full_language.purpose: main experiment: full language/decision fine-tune with the vision tower frozen
J2_full_language.trainable: language/decision body + new heads; vision tower frozen

hard_rules: no stage starts unless the row file and curriculum exist
row provenance must cite a candidate source and the causal shortlist policy
a stage never resumes an optimizer from a different loss/label definition
each stage gets its own runs dir, checkpoint dir and port
